description: This file defines functions for retrieving leaderboard data and related queries for various entities such as customers, items, suppliers, sales partners, and sales persons within the ERPNext system. It includes functions for fetching data with filters, aggregations, and date ranges, and is likely part of the startup or initialization scripts for the application.

methods.name: get_leaderboards
methods.description: Returns a dictionary defining various leaderboards with their respective fields, methods, and icons.

methods.name: get_all_customers
methods.description: Fetches customer data based on date range, company, field, and optional limit, including outstanding amounts and sales.

methods.name: get_all_items
methods.description: Retrieves item data such as stock quantities, sales, and purchase amounts based on filters.

methods.name: get_all_suppliers
methods.description: Fetches supplier data including outstanding amounts and purchase totals.

methods.name: get_all_sales_partner
methods.description: Retrieves sales partner data with total sales and commissions.

methods.name: get_all_sales_person
methods.description: Fetches sales person data with total sales amounts.

methods.name: get_date_condition
methods.description: Constructs SQL date range condition string based on provided date range and field.
